entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. My VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so confused by it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I think it's broken. The numbers it gives me are all over the place. Honestly, the data seems like complete garbage. I really don't have time to mess with it.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sensor's accuracy. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can transfer you to our technical support team, they're experts and can walk you through a few quick steps to see if it's a calibration issue.
Oh, no... I'm not good with all that technical stuff. It sounds complicated and I really don't have time for a long call. Can't you just help me? I just want money back, a refund.
I understand you'd prefer a straightforward solution. Let me pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, I have your account here. Let me see... yes, our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. It looks like you received your VeloBand 15 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So I can get a full refund? That's a huge relief.

Yes, absolutely. I am processing the return authorization for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the sensor back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Sarah. That was much easier than I thought it would be.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
